basic_info.description: This Mediterranean-style center patio residence sits on a quiet block near the shops and eateries of San Francisco's sought after West Portal neighborhood. Inside, a thoughtful layout spans approximately 2,440 sq ft of finished living space with three bedrooms and two and a half bathrooms (per draftsman) across two levels, plus a large garage and two storage areas. The main level offers a formal living room with oversized windows, a formal dining room, and spacious kitchen. Downstairs sits the primary suite an additional half bath, large laundry room and a spacious family/media room that flows seamlessly to a manicured backyard with patio, mature plantings and a built in BBQ and firepitideal for relaxing or entertaining. Garage parking with interior access provides ease and convenience for the homeowner.
